title: Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) Dataset
summary: A data-preparation and synthetic-data-generation project for the PSID longitudinal panel of household income, employment, and demographic records spanning 1987-1996. The accompanying notebook fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on the wide-format PSID data to produce synthetic replacements and evaluate utility, with SDV run directly as the generation engine.
needs: Unclear exact downstream purpose (privacy vs. augmentation) since README only describes dataset structure, not motivation for synthesis.
